title: Meals You Can’t Miss
editorial: Sri Lankan rice and curry became our default meal, and that is not a complaint. A typical plate gives you rice with several vegetable preparations, dhal, sambol and whichever meat or fish you choose.

At Bentota Bake House near Dambulla we tried kiribath, dhal, sambol, egg and chicken curry. Matey Hut in Ella served one of our favourite meals of the trip: rice with several curries including chicken. Chamodya Homestay gave us egg hoppers and pol sambol, while Mirissa added seafood curries and all-you-can-eat spreads such as Dhana’s Curry Pot.

The food is usually less restaurant-theatrical than in neighbouring India, but we liked the homely balance of vegetables, lentils, coconut and meat. If your plate feels light on protein, order an extra meat dish rather than expecting the curry set to do all the lifting.
